goal: Allow valid large UTF-8 files in bounded immutable Review bundles and make frozen breaking Intent revision use one canonical active-path authority action with atomic planning-artifact restoration.

acceptance.assertion: Review capture includes exact Git-index bytes for a UTF-8 openapi.yaml larger than 256 KiB when the complete immutable bundle remains below 2 MiB, while individual or aggregate input beyond the 2 MiB ceiling still fails closed and existing provenance, encoding, and snapshot checks remain intact.

Literal-user-approved breaking Intent revision succeeds from active and genuinely frozen layouts using one canonical active-path authority digest; frozen Intent and bound Spec restore atomically to active paths, while cancellation and pre-commit failure preserve prior bytes, paths, TaskRecord, workspace, claim, and unconsumed authority.
